chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a dog touching something from a man's body. He said: He should wash the place that it touched.

key_terms.أَصَابَهُ: it touched him, referring to the dog's contact with the body
key_terms.الْكَلْبِ: the dog, the animal whose contact is being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَكَانَ: the place, meaning the specific area that was touched
key_terms.جَسَدِ: body, referring to the person's physical body
key_terms.يَغْسِلُ: he should wash, indicating the required action

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a dog touches part of a person's body according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning contact of a dog with a person's body. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that the specific place touched by the dog should be washed, indicating a ruling related to ritual purity.
